dedupe_keys.name: data driven models for predicting structural loads in offshore wind turbines using scada data

description: Tsaklis, Iasonas and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. A three-year Lillgrund dataset supports comparison of XGBoost, artificial neural networks and Gaussian-process regression for blade-root flapwise and tower-bottom fore-aft damage-equivalent loads. Feature-engineering choices vary by turbine and target. The source reports strong prediction performance and a simplified fatigue-estimation example, with XGBoost computational advantages. This is a documented field-data model application; the paper deposit does not establish that the underlying SCADA measurements or trained estimators are publicly downloadable. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. This record represents the documented application and its stated scope. Publication access does not imply that its underlying measurements or implementation are public. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance. The fitted estimators are validated against field-derived structural-load targets.
